pages.text: Monsters at the door? A $(l)Laser Turret$() keeps them out. Give it power and it watches $(l)16 blocks$() all round (a sphere 33 blocks across, as wide as the largest drone work area), turns its head toward the nearest hostile mob it can see and burns it down.

$(li)$(l)8 damage a shot, one shot a second$(): a zombie lasts three shots.$(br)$(li)A shot costs $(l)200 FE$() from its 20,000 FE buffer: $(l)10 FE/t$() while it fights, none while nothing is in sight, so one $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l) keeps four turrets firing.

$(li)Every CyberFarm laser costs $(l)25 FE per point of damage$(), the turret and the $(l:drone_systems/modules)Guard Module$(/l) alike.$(br)$(li)It needs a clear view: no block between its head and the mob's eyes. Glass stops it too.$(br)$(li)It shoots $(l)hostile mobs only$(). Players, animals, villagers and golems are safe,

$(li)and so are $(l)named mobs$(), mobs $(l)riding$() something (a minecart, a boat) and $(l)neutral mobs$() (endermen, zombified piglins) until they get angry. Your mob farms are safe if you name the mobs you keep.

$(li)$(l)Right-click$() it to see what it is doing; the red lens on the barrel lights up while it aims.$(br)Power it with an $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l) or any other mod's cable, from any side.

A turret stays where you put it. For an area that moves with your farm, give a drone a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Guard Module$(/l): it flies over its work area and shoots the same mobs from above. For a big wave, a swarm of Mini Drones with the $(l:drone_systems/modules)Bomb Module$(/l) dives at the monsters and blows up on them.
